label: Lit-up ad screens
text: A night photo of a building covered in giant lit-up advertising screens for Coca-Cola Zero, TDK, Samsung, McDonald's, Vogue, Hyundai, Barclays and GAP, shown under the question Is it Marketing?

label: Myntra End of Reason Sale
text: Myntra's India's Biggest Fashion Sale banner: End of Reason Sale, 3rd to 8th July, 50-80% OFF, up to 12% instant discount on HDFC Bank cards and EasyEMI, upto 8.5% Zingoy cashback. Shown under the question Is it Marketing?

label: Handshake in a car showroom
text: A salesman in a suit shakes hands with a customer in front of a pickup truck in a car showroom, shown under the question Is it Marketing?

label: MTR 3 Minute Indian Breakfast
text: An MTR advert for a 3 Minute Indian Breakfast: just add hot water. New packs of Poha, Oats Homestyle Masala and a cup version.

label: Google
text: The Google logo, shown next to the MTR breakfast advert on the slide that follows 'meeting needs profitably'.

label: Goods and services that can be marketed
text: Goods: cars, furniture, TV, refrigerator, machines, fresh food, canned food. Services: hotels, airlines, banking, consulting, renting.

label: Events that can be marketed
text: Trade shows, exhibitions, sporting events and local time-based markets.

label: Zomaland by Zomato
text: Zomato presents zomaland, India's Grandest Carnival (with Paytm and Ballantine's logos): the slide's picture for marketing an experience.

label: Persons who can be marketed
text: Artists, musicians, athletes, CEO's, lawyers and financiers.

label: Bangalore, The Silicon Valley of India
text: A city at night captioned Bangalore, The Silicon Valley of India: the slide's picture for marketing a place.

label: Space Hippie: THIS IS TRASH.
text: A sneaker advert: THIS IS TRASH. At least 50% of this sneaker weighs in at pure trash. Introducing Space Hippie, one big step with a small footprint. The slide's picture for marketing an idea.

label: Coffee cup picture
text: A takeaway coffee cup with a round green logo, shown beside 'Drives Business growth'.

label: Apple-shaped logo
text: A grey apple-shaped logo, shown beside 'Builds reputation'.

label: Hanging sachets
text: Long strips of small single-use sachets (some printed Dove) hanging in a shop, shown beside 'Understanding consumer behaviour'.

label: GoPro camera
text: A person filming themselves in the snow with a GoPro camera, shown beside 'Promotes awareness'.

label: Industry and market flows
text: A diagram with Industry (a collection of sellers) and Market (a collection of buyers). Goods/services and communication flow from the industry to the market; money and information flow from the market back to the industry.

label: Glasses that show OUR PRODUCT
text: A pair of glasses whose lenses each show an orange box labelled OUR PRODUCT, placed beside the definition of marketing myopia.

label: Kodak film roll and NOKIA phone pictures
text: Pictures of a yellow film roll labelled Kodak 200 (35mm color print film) and an old keypad phone with NOKIA printed on it, shown beside the definition of marketing myopia. The slide gives no written explanation of them.

label: Water: need, want, demand
text: Need: I physically need water to survive. Want: I want clean, safe to drink, good tasting water. Demand: I create a demand for Smartwater since it is vapor distilled with added electrolytes for taste.

label: Communication and transportation pictures
text: Need: Access to Communication; want: a simple drawing of a phone; demand: a photo of a particular smartphone model. Need: Transportation; want: a simple drawing of a car; demand: a photo of a particular white SUV. No brand names are printed.

label: Examples of services
text: Banking, airline, hotel and household appliance repair services.

label: THEIR NEEDS + SOCIETY FIRST sign
text: A cartoon man on the societal marketing concept slide holds a sign reading THEIR NEEDS + SOCIETY FIRST = BETTER BUSINESS.

label: Marketing mix tree
text: A tree diagram with Marketing mix at the top and the tools under each P. Product: product variety, quality, design, features, brand name, packaging, sizes, services, warranties, returns. Price: list price, discounts, allowances, payment period, credit terms. Place: channels, coverage, assortments, locations, inventory, transport. Promotion: sales promotion, advertising, sales force, public relations, direct marketing.

label: Marketing mix picture with seven elements
text: An illustration titled Marketing Mix (Source: Shutterstock) with seven labelled icons: Product, Price, Place, Promotion, People, Physical Environment and Process.

label: Drink photos on the intermediaries slide
text: Two photos under Marketing Intermediaries: a paper cup printed BURGER KING and pepsi with fries behind it, and a glass printed Coca-Cola on a tray against a red background with yellow arch-shaped logos.

label: Man carrying P&G boxes
text: A photo beside the Public points: a man carrying stacked blue boxes printed P&G in front of a truck that also shows P&G.

label: Photos on the demographic slide
text: Two photos: a skier racing downhill seated on a ski frame, and a tall sign printed IKEA beside a large blue and yellow store with a car park.

label: TATA MOTORS nano ad
text: A print ad on the economic environment slide: a small yellow car marked nano under the headline now you can, with lines such as Can you imagine a car within the reach of all? and Can you find more miles in your every litre? Printed brand words: TATA, TATA MOTORS, nano.

label: Photos on the natural environment slide
text: Two photos: a pile of cardboard delivery boxes printed amazon at a front door, and a tall silver appliance with an open loop on top, with red lines drawn streaming out of it across a living room.

label: Healthcare Technology trends in 2021
text: A picture headed Healthcare Technology trends in 2021: a woman in a face mask and face shield, and a humanoid robot holding the hand of an older woman sitting on a bed, with the link https://healthcare.report/.

label: MAKE IN INDIA picture
text: On the political and legal environment slide: a lion made of gears with the words MAKE IN INDIA across it, on orange, white and green waves.

label: Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk gifting ad
text: A purple ad with a gift box of chocolates printed Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk and a decorative thread with a round ornament. Text: Celebrate Rishton ki Mithas with Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk Gifting.

label: LEVER ayush ad
text: An ad with the headline 5000 year old Ayurveda for today's beauty problems and a row of LEVER ayush products: a soap bar, Anti Pimple Turmeric Face Wash, Purifying Turmeric Handwash and Anti Marks Turmeric Face Cream.

label: PESTEL graphic
text: Six tiles spelling P E S T E L: Political (handshake), Economic (rising bar chart), Social (person), Technological (light bulb with gears), Environmental (globe), Legal (gavel).

label: SWOT grid
text: A two by two grid: rows Internal (Strengths, Weaknesses) and External (Opportunities, Threats); columns Positive (Strengths, Opportunities) and Negative (Weaknesses, Threats), each box with its one-line meaning.
